title: Last Stone Weight
prompt:
Each turn, smash the two heaviest stones together: if unequal, the difference becomes a new stone. Return the weight of the last remaining stone (0 if none remain).

**Example**: `[2,7,4,1,8,1]` → `1`.

A max-heap gives you the two heaviest in O(log n) each turn.
hints: While at least two stones remain, poll two; if they differ, offer the difference.
Return the last stone, or 0 if the heap emptied.

solution.explanation: O(n log n). The simulation needs the two largest each round, which is exactly what a max-heap serves in O(log n); equal stones vanish (offer nothing), unequal leave a remainder stone.
